title: College of Fine Arts bachelor rules
notes: Selected requirements the college states are common to all its programs, plus declared-major admission. Programs can require a higher major GPA.

rules.label: Upper-division coursework
rules.statement: Of at least 120 credits, complete at least 42 in courses numbered at the 300 or 400 level. This is a subset of degree credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: at least 42 credit hours must be completed in courses numbered in the 300- or 400-level

rules.label: Degree GPA
rules.statement: Have a UNM GPA of at least 2.00 and at least 2.00 on all credits attempted while enrolled in the College of Fine Arts.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: UNM grade point average of 2.00 or higher

rules.label: Major GPA
rules.statement: Graduate with at least a 2.75 GPA in the major; some degrees require more.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: minimum 2.75 grade point in their major

rules.label: Physical education activity
rules.statement: No more than four credits of nonprofessional physical education count toward a degree.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: No more than four credit hours of nonprofessional physical education

rules.label: Declared-major earned credit
rules.statement: Complete at least 26 earned credits before admission as a declared major.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: Completion of 26 hours of earned credit

rules.label: Declared-major admission GPA
rules.statement: Have at least a 2.50 GPA on all UNM credits attempted, or on the last 30 credits attempted. The page lists further admission conditions, including major coursework at 2.5.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: A grade point average of at least 2.50 in all credit hours attempted at UNM
